querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_windcode,
                                      trade_dt,
                                      boll_mid,
                                      boll_upper,
                                      boll_lower,
                                      bbiboll_bbi,
                                      bbiboll_upr,
                                      bbiboll_dwn,
                                      cdp,
                                      cdp_ah,
                                      cdp_al,
                                      cdp_nh,
                                      cdp_nl,
                                      env_upper,
                                      env_lower,
                                      mike_wr,
                                      mike_mr,
                                      mike_sr,
                                      mike_ws,
                                      mike_ms,
                                      mike_ss,
                                      mfi,
                                      obv,
                                      obv_obv,
                                      pvt,
                                      wvad_wvad,
                                      wvad_mawvad,
                                      arbr_ar,
                                      arbr_br,
                                      cr,
                                      psy,
                                      psyma,
                                      wad,
                                      mawad,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_ashareenergyindex.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.ashareenergyindex WHERE trade_dt BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
